method: Ordered finite two-school review of every available subsection in Tzidkat HaTzadik 60–264. Each entry records its actual comparisons, including rejections; completion of the full range is reported only when all available references have an entry. The missing Siman 74 is an unavailable source, never a completed conceptual review. The saved comprehensive checkpoint is reconciled additively with the existing ledger, preserving earlier assessments and adding the recovered candidate comparisons. Reconciled with the completed recovered review through Siman 264: preserve the published source records and prior decisions, and document further independently completed comparisons.
